contests.title: North Union Community School District — Measure HF: School addition bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Kossuth County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the North Union Community School District in the Counties of Emmet, Kossuth and
Palo Alto, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount
not to exceed $12,000,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to the school building, including a
gymnasium, multipurpose room, and related spaces, and to improve the site?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $12 million in general-obligation bonds for additions to the school building, including a gymnasium, a multipurpose room and related spaces, and site improvements.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Official November 3, 2026 election page links the statewide federal and state candidate inventory, enumerates every office and district range, and states that candidates are added only after Elections Division review and acceptance.

Party-only placeholder rows are not candidates. No incumbent or website fields are printed.
